scope: Stationary noiseless abstract policy with exact fixed rebuild cost and persistent exact age-prefix observations. Conservative predictor replaces an unobserved age by the largest known age; this is an idealization, not a claim that the deployed predictor uses it. Does not model non-stationarity, noisy estimation, phase coupling, or production-code equivalence.
caveats: The previous verification.json (Windows x64) recorded 131 theorems and remains the record for the pre-Conservative state; this file supersedes it only for the Linux run that includes Conservative.lean.
paper_source_sha256 is not repeated here: this addition does not change any paper source. The paper has not yet been edited to use the conservative predictor.

Conservative.lean proves the ideal noiseless case only. The measured 44.5% overestimation rate pertains to the linear-secant predictor used by the current code, and is what motivates the conservative variant; it is not evidence about the conservative variant itself.
